Slide 25: Oregon ranks near the top of expenditures and own source revenue as a share of personal income
tldr: Oregon ranks near the top of states in state and local expenditures and own-source revenue as a share of personal income. In 2022, Oregon's combined state-local expenditures (including federal transfers) represented 24.7% of personal income, while own-source revenue (excluding federal transfers) ranked 44th nationally at 30.4% of personal income.

bullets.text: State and local expenditures as share of personal income (2022, including federal transfers): Oregon at 24.7%
Own source revenue – State and Local combined: Oregon ranks 44th at 30.4%
Own source revenue – State only: Oregon ranks 47th
Own source revenue – Local only: Oregon ranks 31st at 19.5%
Apples-to-apples comparison is challenging; unique factors like Oregon's Kicker and inconsistent state/local reporting affect interpretation
